four_dimensional_negative_ADE_wall.principle: Known LeBrun/Ishida-LeBrun nonexistence is generated by non-crepant topology (blowups or connected-sum deficit). Ricci-pinched ALE gluing naturally uses Ricci-flat Kronheimer/ADE crepant bubbles, which preserve c1^2. The two mechanisms therefore miss each other.

burns_check.pinching_scaling_consequence: If a scaled Burns core is t*g_Burns, its nonzero Ricci endomorphism scales like t^{-1}; hence a Burns (-1)-bubble cannot be hidden in a sequence with ||Ric+g||_op -> 0 by the same Ricci-flat ALE mechanism.

n_ge_5_codim4_stratum_probe.local_model: codimension-four orbifold stratum S^m with normal cone R^4/Gamma and ALE replacement X_Gamma
n_ge_5_codim4_stratum_probe.operator_norm_locality: Yau-26 pinching is a C^0 pointwise operator norm; a first obstruction coefficient that is nonzero at any stratum point gives an O(1) Ricci endomorphism defect on the corresponding core, so integration over S cannot cancel it.
n_ge_5_codim4_stratum_probe.expected_first_obstruction_form: bundle-valued pointwise/elliptic condition along S: R_normal,±(y) zeta(y) plus possible normal-connection/tangential derivative terms must vanish, rather than only an integral condition

variation_warning_model.scaling_message: multiplying the fiber metric by a small constant does not suppress curvature produced by O(1) variation of the fiber parameter along y; analogously, ALE parameters over a stratum must be parallel/slow in a scale-correct gauge or create visible mixed curvature

n_ge_5_codim4_stratum_probe.bounded_verdict: The n>=5 stratum idea has content, but the naive stratum-integral obstruction is too weak. The correct probe is existence/classification of nonzero parallel or elliptic kernel sections in the ALE obstruction bundle over each codim-4 stratum, with pointwise normal curvature block constraints.
n_ge_5_codim4_stratum_probe.does_not_solve: no all-dimensional Yau-26 branch follows from this bounded probe
